newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil trades sideways, crude support holds.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil trades sideways, crude support holds.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures traded sideways on Monday after opening weaker, with crude holding above and gas oil making an unconvincing dip below initial support as traders awaited fresh direction from NYMEX.

Gas oil was the more volatile of the two. At 1252 GMT the September contract stood $1.75 lower at $169.50 a tonne after opening $1.25 down at $170 and then dipping through initial support at $169 but later making a small recovery.
October Brent was 14 cents lower at $18.85 a barrel at 1258 GMT, holding in a narrow six-cent range with support at $18.80.
